stem:
A family makes homemade pickles. They pack the pickles at a rate of 80 pickles per 5 jars.

Which answer choices best represent packing y pickles in x jars at that rate?

options.text:
[Graph: Homemade Pickles
 y-axis labeled Number of Pickles from 0 to 80 in increments of 10
 x-axis labeled Number of Jars from 0 to 6
 Line plotted starting just after 3 on x to 5 on x and about 60 to 80 on y]

[Graph: Homemade Pickles
 y-axis labeled Number of Pickles from 0 to 80 in increments of 10
 x-axis labeled Number of Jars from 0 to 6
 Line plotted from origin (0,0) to (6, 80)]
